title: Research pass — WEF data-governance council carryover root
summary: Starts the cross-term roster graph with evidence-class separation, identifies two directly supported Data Policy-to-Data Equity carryovers, and selects reconstruction of the 30-member historical Data Policy roster as the first recursive unit.

sources.title: JoAnn Stonier - Agenda Contributor | World Economic Forum

sources.publisher: German National Academy of Sciences Leopoldina
sources.title: Maria-Elena Torres-Padilla

data.research_question: What bounded graph should follow the completed Hsiao chronology?
data.method: Start from the least complete historical roster and preserve evidence type before any cross-term count.
classification_rules: Dated person membership outranks undated current-profile historical claims.
Organization membership is not silently converted to person membership.
Publication participation is not council membership without independent confirmation.
Recurrence is not influence or continuous service.

findings.finding: The historical Data Policy surface can already be partitioned into dated person, undated person and organization-membership evidence classes.
Hsiao and Stonier are directly supported carryovers from Data Policy into the 2023 Data Equity member/author set.
